Today the hiatus ended with the airing of "Canterlot Boutique," written by Amy Keating Rogers (and what a fabulous new episode it was!) So, this is the place to discuss the episode, and remember to spoiler any other posts about the episode for 48 hours after the air date!

I personally loved this episode! Something that I've always prized with Rarity episodes is that the show staff took the pony with the highest potential to be a throwaway-teaparty-look-at-my-dress pony and made her smart, business savvy, and a professional creative-type. This episode was no exception, and I think it may be one of the best examples to date! First things first, a new boutique in Canterlot! That's a pretty big change on it's own, and really shows how the characters are evolving and growing rather than stagnating. And those dress designs! Absolutely stunning. Props to the asset designers! Sassy was a perfect example of someone with all the right ideas to run a business full tilt, but lacking enough business sense to sustain it while maintaining the quality around the place. In the end, Rarity's better understanding of the situation saved the day (well, she nearly closed the boutique in the process, but at least she caught herself in time). I'm glad that she was kept as the manager in the end (new reoccurring character maybe?), and that she did eventually get what Rarity was trying to express the entire time. It's interesting to note that all of the other boutiques that she worked at had closed down (probably for the same reasons). 9.5/10I may be biased because I see so much of myself in Rarity (or maybe the hiatus just got to me), but I give this episode 9.5/10! It's another shining example of MLP's best slice of life episodes, and I look forward to seeing what character development waits for our ponies in the future!
